entities.summary: Paul Burty Haviland was a French-American photographer, writer and arts critic who was closely associated with Alfred Stieglitz and the Photo-Secession. Paul Haviland was a painters & sculptors from 8th arrondissement of Paris (1880-06-17, 8th arrondissement of Paris–1950-12-21). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
